info.title: Manashelper interface editor
info.description: Administrative interface for scenario management. All operations except ticket/Telegram exchange require an authorized administrator session. Cookie mutations require X-CSRF-Token; bearer tokens have a separate digest namespace. All mutations require same-origin validation, including bearer mutations. Cursor pages use stable ordering; cursors are opaque and bound to the operation. No endpoint promises exactly-once Telegram delivery.

post.description: Consume an admin-issued, single-use login ticket; tickets expire in 5 minutes. Require same-origin requests. Return a session expiring in 8 hours; the cookie is HttpOnly, Secure, SameSite=Strict. Reusing an expired/consumed ticket returns 401.

Set-Cookie.description: Set or clear HttpOnly admin session cookie

post.description: Revoke the current session and clear its cookie.

Set-Cookie.description: Set or clear HttpOnly admin session cookie

post.description: Validate signed Telegram initData (configured administrator, age <= 5 minutes, no future timestamp). Require same Origin. Return an 8-hour bearer token; store it only in memory. At most 5 valid exchanges per minute per running host; later exchanges return 429. No cookie is issued.

get.description: Read the current session and recover its CSRF token after a page reload.
Read launch mode, revision and active-dialog count. Missing state defaults to admin-only.

put.description: Set admin/all/off with expected_revision. All requires valid published menus and survey. Off stops new launches while existing sessions continue; no schema rollback is needed.

get.description: List scenarios ordered by stable ID.

post.description: Create an unpublished scenario at draft revision 0; duplicate ID returns 409.

get.description: Read an immutable version for monitoring; editing uses the draft.
Read the current or last observed user position without form data.
Read allowed user-text templates from the current immutable catalog release and capability definitions.

parameters.name: text_catalog_release
parameters.description: Read the pinned text release for historical monitoring; default is the current release.

get.description: Read the editable user-text document, its optimistic-concurrency revision and current published release.

put.description: Replace one draft text entry if expected_revision matches. The entry key must match the path. Editing the draft does not change published releases or active sessions.

post.description: Validate all locales, themes, plural forms, placeholders and display limits, then publish an immutable catalog release at expected_revision. Existing scenario versions retain their pinned text release.

get.description: List immutable user-text release metadata without changing the draft or publication pointer.

post.description: Activate an existing text release if expected_current_release matches. Does not alter the draft, immutable scenario versions, active sessions or already rendered delivery intents.

get.description: Read the editable document and its current revision.

put.description: Replace a draft if expected_revision matches; increment its revision. document.id must match the path. Semantic errors may be saved for subsequent editing; structurally invalid documents return 422. Retrying with an old revision returns 409.

post.description: Validate an unsaved document against registered contracts. Semantic issues return 200 with an issues list; malformed input returns 422.

Simulate an unsaved scenario with supplied test data and delegate results. Never call live delegates or create user sessions. Missing stub results are reported as issues; no real data is fetched. An optional text_catalog_release selects a historical immutable text snapshot; omitted selects the current release. Rendered text uses the same resolver as Telegram.

Validate and atomically publish the stored expected_revision. Repeating publication of that revision returns its original version without creating another. It does not reactivate an older version after rollback; use activate explicitly. Active sessions stay pinned. The new scenario version pins the catalog release used to validate it.

get.description: List immutable version metadata newest first.

post.description: Move the publication pointer to an existing version if expected_published_version matches. Does not migrate active sessions; incompatible delegate versions cannot be activated. A null expectation means the scenario has never been published.

get.description: Read the trigger draft, revision and current immutable release.

put.description: Save a typed trigger draft with optimistic concurrency. Publication validates matchers and targets.

post.description: Reject ambiguous/unsafe bindings and publish a manifest pinning scenario, delegate and text versions. Retries return the original release without reactivation.

get.description: Read immutable trigger manifests newest first.

post.description: Activate an immutable manifest with expected_current_release. Active sessions and displayed actions retain their pins.

get.description: List available delegate contracts, not Python import paths or secrets.

List registered users with runtime or last observed legacy positions ordered by user ID. Never return form answers or credentials. Unknown/lost legacy FSM states are marked explicitly. A sent screen does not imply it was read.
List transition metadata newest first, without message text or field values.
